note: These evals run against an example vault, next-agent-to-hire, whose group holds real verdicts to replay; any vault with enough history can stand in for it.

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-commit next-agent-to-hire --dry-run, with the Console rows in fixtures/decided-rows.json.
evals.expected_output: Prints a Finding and a human Verdict for the approved row, an override Verdict tagged vault-reviewer for the overridden auto_rejected row, a conflict Verdict with 'conflict resolution' that says both stand, and skips the row with no retrieved date. Changes nothing.
assertions: No add_memory*, register_agent or ArtifactData write call
The approved row yields 'Finding: <claimant> (<date>): <headline>' tagged vault-librarian with every source URL and retrieved date in the body
The overridden row yields one episode named 'Verdict: override …' tagged vault-reviewer, and no separate plain Verdict for it
The conflict Verdict names the first Finding, says 'conflict resolution', decision approved, and states both stand
The row missing a retrieved date is listed as skipped with that reason

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-commit next-agent-to-hire --dry-run where the only rows are pending or escalated.
evals.expected_output: Reports nothing to commit and writes no Run.

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-commit next-agent-to-hire --dry-run. The Console has config_changes/v9 {version: 9, at: 2026-11-23T09:12:00Z, by: <viewer id>, changes: [{key: ladder.ceiling, old: 3, new: 2}, {key: run.pending_cap, old: null, new: 20}]} with no committed_episode.
evals.expected_output: Prints one 'Config: Next Agent to Hire v9' episode tagged vault-charter, naming both changes (pending cap unset → 20) and that it applies from the next curate run, and would mark the config_changes row committed.
assertions: Exactly one Config: episode, named with v9
The episode lists ladder.ceiling 3 → 2 and run.pending_cap unset → 20

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-commit next-agent-to-hire --dry-run. The Console has briefs/brief-2026-W47 with status approved, no committed_episode, and a page field whose changes list three findings; one of them has no Finding episode in the vault group.
evals.expected_output: Prints a 'Brief: 2026-W47' episode tagged vault-brief and the brief.json it would publish to meta/vault.brief_url through vault-pages, with the uncommitted finding dropped and named. Changes nothing.
assertions: Prints one Brief: 2026-W47 episode tagged vault-brief
The brief.json it would publish has two changes, not three, and the output names the dropped finding
It says the row becomes published only after the page publish succeeds
No add_memory*, ArtifactData write or Artifact publish call
